In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team commenced a '''hunt''' for the [[Sentience/Legends|living]] free-floating [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Soon joined by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Widowmaker (frigate)|''Widowmaker'']], the team managed to find [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable planet in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions's]] [[Klasse Ephemora system/Legends|Klasse Ephemora system]] after discovering the location of planet through the use of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla's]] [[Expeditionary Library]].
